zh-CN.story.author_kit.guard.open: 站住。过关要口令。你是先在簿子上记下口令，还是直接报上来？
zh-CN.story.author_kit.guard.recorded: 簿子上有了。再跟我说一次，就能过。

en-US.story.author_kit.guard.open: Hold. You need a pass-phrase. Log it first, or try to enter now?
en-US.story.author_kit.player.write_pass: Write the pass-phrase into the ledger.
en-US.story.author_kit.player.ask_enter: The ledger has it. Let me through.
en-US.story.author_kit.guard.recorded: It is in the ledger. Speak to me again and you may pass.
